info.title: API.SH: AlternativeTo
info.description: The AlternativeTo API from API.SH: public AlternativeTo data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The crowd-ranked alternatives to an app, with every filter the site offers: platform, license, feature, origin, install and sort. Each alternative has the app fields (name, slug, link, description, likes, alternatives count, rating, license, platforms, categories, highlights, company, icon, screenshots) and the top comments about it as an alternative. `filters` lists the available platform, license, feature, origin and install filters with counts; `total` is the number of alternatives. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/alternativeto-alternatives

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The app's AlternativeTo slug, or a link.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform slug, e.g. windows, mac, linux, android, iphone, online, self-hosted.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Where the maker is based: a region (americas, europe, eu, asia) or country code (us, gb, de, fr, ...).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One app on AlternativeTo: id, name, slug, link, short and full description, tagline, likes, alternatives count, review count, rating, license cost and model, license, platforms, categories and highlighted features, feature and property tags with likes, company and country, icon, screenshots, release date, pricing and pricing text, links (official site, app stores, social), install packages (winget, brew, ...), supported languages, creator, added and updated dates, the review summary, GitHub stats for open-source apps, the top alternatives, the reviews shown on the page (rating, mood, text, date, author, replies) with the total, and related news, with the site's record in `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/alternativeto-software

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
